name: stack-fusion-ziyiliu-top
description: Monorepo for Stack Fusion Ziyiliu platform.

scripts.clean:all: npm run clean --workspace backend && npm run clean --workspace frontend && rm -rf ./node_modules && rm -rf ./package-lock.json
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:hot --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --workspace backend" "npm run preview --workspace frontend"

author: Ziyi LIU
